g.text: One platform that runs a whole home-healthcare business: a public booking
site, a client portal, a mobile-first staff portal and a 32-module admin
Geospatial decision support that ranks 13,021 areas across Sri Lanka to
show where to lay fibre next, and explains why each area was or was not
An agentic food-exploration platform. One plain-language message goes to a
coordinator that calls six specialist AI services in parallel and returns
